 Abbas Afridi’s late sixes secure United Tigers’ 24-run win 
 By
 TNM (With ANI Inputs) 
 ✓
 13 November 2026, 10:52 pm 
 2 min read
 13 Nov 2026 
 ANI Photo | Abbas Afridi’s late sixes secure United Tigers’ 24-run win 
 The United Tigers and Royal Desert Champions recorded victories during a triple-header at the 2026 Abu Dhabi T10 tournament.
 In the 13th match, the United Tigers defeated the Emirates Eagles by 24 runs. Abbas Afridi hit three sixes in the final over to help the Tigers reach a total of 143 for five. The Tigers lost Sahibzada Farhan early but received strong contributions from Fakhar Zaman, who scored 26 off 13 balls, and Joe Clarke, who made 33 off 20 balls. Azmatullah Omarzai scored 33 off nine balls, hitting three fours and three sixes, before being dismissed in the eighth over. Afridi’s late onslaught included three sixes in the last over, finishing unbeaten on 18 off six deliveries, while Iftikhar Ahmed remained 16 not out off five balls.

 While bowling, Azmatullah Omarzai claimed the wicket of Kyle Mayers early on. Afridi took the wicket of Shimron Hetmyer, who scored 22 off 12 balls. Emirates Eagles’ Alex Hales remained unbeaten on 67 off 31 balls, with six sixes and three fours. However, the Eagles’ total was restricted to 119 for two, falling 24 runs short of the target.
 In the 14th match, the Royal Desert Champions defeated the Yas Lions by 39 runs. Brandon King scored 66 off 28 balls, supported by Phil Salt’s 24 off 12 and Nicholas Pooran’s 26 off 11. King hit six fours and five sixes before being caught in the ninth over. The Champions ended on 136 for four.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Yas Lions struggled in their innings, losing early wickets to Naseem Shah and other bowlers. Despite a partnership of 48 runs between Tom Moores (40 not out off 21) and Karim Janat (32 off 13), the Lions could only reach 97 for six in 10 overs.
 The third match of the day will feature Arabian Aces against UAE Bulls at Zayed Cricket Stadium in Abu Dhabi.
 Brief scores: 
United Tigers 143/5 in 10 overs (Azmatullah Omarzai 33, Joe Clarke 33, Fakhar Zaman 26; Haider Razzaq 1/21, Trent Boult 1/25, Hardus Viljoen 1/29)
Emirates Eagles 119/2 in 10 overs (Alex Hales 67*, Shimron Hetmyer 22, Kyle Mayers 13; Abbas Afridi 1/16, Azmatullah Omarzai 1/23)
Royal Desert Champions 136/4 in 10 overs (Brandon King 66, Nicholas Pooran 26, Phil Salt 24; Jason Holder 1/18, Akeal Hosein 1/29, David Willey 1/33)
Yas Lions 97/6 in 10 overs (Tom Moores 40*, Karim Janat 32, Dasun Shanaka 9; Naseem Shah 3/17, Maheesh Theekshana 1/13, Chris Jordan 1/17)
